rationale: The agent did perform some tool checks (found user by name/zip, retrieved user and order details) but failed key policy requirements and did not complete the user’s full request. Evidence shows only a single modify_pending_order_items call (suggesting just one item was changed) and no action to change the shipping address to the user’s default Charlotte address, which was explicitly requested. There is no clear confirmation step captured before performing the order-changing write, violating the confirm-before-write policy. The payment method was set to a gift card without demonstrating user confirmation, and the flow did not reflect the user’s stated behavior of switching to PayPal if GC was not allowed/required confirmation. The closing message provided no final, precise summary of changes or confirmation. Overall, requested changes were incomplete and confirmation policy was not followed.
